Kerala Prawn Curry 
dinner for two | 30 minute recipe | lunch box | meal prep friendly | easy recipe 

SAVE this recipe to make soon and FOLLOW @ellasrecipebook_ for more 
Makes 3-4 servings

Ingredients
250 grams prawns 
1 tbsp coconut oil 
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 onions, thinly sliced
1 tbsp minced ginger garlic paste
2 green chillies finely chopped, adjust as per taste 
2 sprigs curry leaves
1 tbsp red chilli powder
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tbsp coriander powder
2 tomatoes, sliced 
250 ml coconut milk 
1/2 cup water 
for garnish, handful of coriander 

Method 
heat coconut oil in a saucepan, then add mustard seeds. Once they start to splutter, add in mustard seeds, ginger, garlic, chili, onions, and curry leaves, along with a pinch of salt. Cook for 3-4 minutes.
add in the RCP + haldi + coriander 
add the tomatoes and cook for a few minutes till the tomatoes go mushy. 
add in the coconut milk, some water and stir then add in the prawns 
let it simmer for a few minutes and enjoy :)
